current_point.claim: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN，用于分布式场景下的基于图神经网络的图表示学习。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN, for graph representation learning based on graph neural networks in distributed scenarios.
technical_features: 可以在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习
使用图摘要技术生成规模远小于原图的子图
领导节点负责同步更新GNN模型参数
technical_features_en: Performs mini-batch sample learning on subgraphs at worker nodes
Generates subgraphs much smaller than the original graph using graph summarization technology
The leader node is responsible for synchronously updating the GNN model parameters
